name: g58_magic_bounce_semi_holder
purpose: G58 (decision 0015 5ax, the semi-invulnerable exemptions; Magic Bounce, data/abilities.ts:2440): Sableye (M, Sablenite) mega-evolves and charges Phantom Force on turn 1; on turn 2 Gengar (M, Poison type) Toxic, a reflectable status move, aimed at the charging Mega Sableye: the Invulnerability step lets a Poison-type Toxic through (sim/battle-actions.ts:627-628) and Magic Bounce does not bounce a semi-invulnerable holder, so Toxic lands on Sableye. Seeded from the G57 Magic Bounce battles.
